messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 44):
"""
24) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/25/02/2021dat ed 03.02.2021 Guidelines on Standard Vector Borne diseases 25) IRDA/HLT/GDL/MISC/036/02/2021d ated 25.02.2021 Guidelines on Standard Personal Accident Policy ‘Saral Suraksha Bima’ 26) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/038/03/2021 dated 01.03.2021 Information on health insurance policies to the policyholders were specified. 27) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/049/03/2021d ated 16.03.2021 Partial modification of existing guidelines on product filing in health insurance business. 28) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/051/03/2021 dated 18.03.2021 Modification of Arogya Sanjeevani. 29) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/058/03/2021d ated 23.03.2021 Modification of Guidelines on Standard Personal Accident Insurance product 30) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/ 119/05/2021 dated 15.05.2021 Guidelines on Standard Domestic Travel Insurance Product” Bharat Yatra Suraksha” . 31) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/046/03/2022 dated 07.03.2022 Disclosure of underwriting philosophy 32) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/102/5/2022 dated 23.05.2022 Modification of Returns on standardization of health insurance products under the circular dated 22.7.2020. 33) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/104/5/2022 dated 27.05.2022 Modification of definitions issued under the circular dated22.7.2020.

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
